history.description: AKV Nuditaranga 2026 v2.3.17: Working Committee Attendance Excel Export Fix: Resolved the issue where exported Working Committee Excel workbooks were generated empty with 0 data rows even though attendance was marked.; Working Committee Member Query Normalization: Fixed get_wc_members_query in working_committee_attendance.py by removing the restrictive User.role != 'SUPERADMIN' filter that inadvertently excluded working committee coordinators and admins, ensuring all users designated with is_working_committee=True, admin_type='WORKING_COMMITTEE', role='WORKING_COMMITTEE', volunteer_domain='Working Committee', or working_committee_role are properly recognized.; Marked Attendance Member Inclusion Safeguard: Added query safeguards across export_working_committee_excel (working_committee_attendance.py), export_attendance_excel (attendance.py), and get_working_committee_attendance (roster API) to automatically include any user with attendance records in working_committee_attendance, guaranteeing no marked attendance record is ever dropped from generated Excel workbooks or UI rosters.; Accurate Timestamp & Status Formatting in Workbooks: Enhanced export date columns across all sheets to output precise Indian Standard Time (IST) check-in and check-out timestamps when present, and explicit 'Present' / 'Absent' indicators instead of blank or placeholder fields.

AKV Nuditaranga 2026 v2.3.16: Profile Edit Window Reopened Till October 10, 2026: Extended the one-time profile details edit window until October 10, 2026, 11:59 PM IST (2026-10-10T23:59:59+05:30) across backend validation (auth.py) and frontend profile management UI (MyProfileAttendance.jsx), allowing registered students, volunteers, and coordinators to correct their Name, AUID, Email, Phone, Department, Year of Study, Domain, and Profile Photo.; All-Users Broadcast Email Notification System: Implemented send_profile_edit_reopened_email in email_service.py with bilingual (Kannada & English) branded email templates, and added POST /api/superadmin/broadcast/profile-edit-reopened for asynchronous background broadcast.; Broadcast Trigger & Profile Lock Controls in SuperAdmin Portal: Added high-visibility Profile Edit Window status card and controls to SuperAdmin Dashboard overview with 1-click 'Send Notification to All Users' and 'Unlock All Profile Locks', backed by POST /api/superadmin/users/{user_id}/reset-profile-edit and POST /api/superadmin/users/reset-all-profile-edits.; In-App Notification Banners & AuthPortal Alert: Updated RoleUpdatesBanner across Superadmin, Admin, Volunteer, and Participant dashboards with v2.3.16 cache key reset so all logged-in users immediately receive the announcement banner, and mounted an official announcement notice in AuthPortal above login and registration cards.; Standalone CLI Broadcast Script: Created scripts/broadcast_profile_edit_notice.py supporting dry runs, role filtering, lock resets, and live email dispatch with automated progress and delivery reporting.

AKV Nuditaranga 2026 v2.3.15: Working Committee Attendance Member Isolation: Restricted the working committee attendance roster and marking controls strictly to verified Working Committee members (is_working_committee is True, role is WORKING_COMMITTEE, volunteer_domain is Working Committee, or admin_type is WORKING_COMMITTEE with role in ADMIN/WORKING_COMMITTEE).; Eliminated Registered Students & Volunteers Leakage into Working Committee: Removed the blanket User.working_committee_role.isnot(None) condition that previously captured all registered students due to database column defaults, ensuring normal students, participants, and department volunteers never appear in the Working Committee attendance section.; Database Default Cleanups & Safe Onboarding: Removed default='Coordinator' and default='WORKING_COMMITTEE' from User model in models.py, ensured register_student sets is_working_committee=False and working_committee_role=None, and added migration cleanup in database.py stripping dummy working committee assignments from non-committee students.; Enhanced Member Assignment & Un-designation: Improved add_or_assign_wc_member in working_committee_attendance.py to designate existing users by AUID or email without account duplication errors, added DELETE /api/working-committee-attendance/members/{user_id} and api.removeWorkingCommitteeMember for easy member removal, and updated table header to 'Role / Domain' in SuperAdminDashboard.; Frontend Code-Splitting & 75% Initial Bundle Reduction: Converted SuperAdminDashboard (7,000+ lines), AdminPage, DeveloperPortal, CheckInPage, ResetPasswordView, ConfirmationPage, and RulesPage to dynamic React.lazy with Suspense and branded loading spinners. The initial entry chunk shrunk from 1,460 kB to 363 kB (75 kB gzip) for lightning-fast public initial load.; Vendor Chunk Isolation & DNS Prefetching: Configured Vite rollupOptions.output.manualChunks to split React, icons, confetti, and heavy QR scanner modules into independent cached vendor chunks. Added dns-prefetch and preconnect hints for Google Fonts in index.html for instant font rendering.; SQLite High-Concurrency Tuning (WAL Mode & Memory Cache): Configured SQLAlchemy connection listener for SQLite: enabled PRAGMA journal_mode=WAL for non-blocking concurrent reads and writes, PRAGMA synchronous=NORMAL, 64MB RAM page cache (cache_size=-64000), in-memory temp tables (temp_store=MEMORY), 256MB mmap_size, and 10s busy_timeout to eliminate 'database is locked' errors during festival peak traffic.; High-Performance Database Indexes & N+1 Query Elimination: Created 24 composite and single indexes across users, registrations, events, attendance, checkin logs, and audit logs for both SQLite and PostgreSQL. Batch-loaded user attributes in Working Committee and volunteer audit log routes, eliminating round-trip N+1 query loops.

AKV Nuditaranga 2026 v2.3.14: Volunteer & Working Committee Attendance Real-Time Today Marking Fix: Fixed multi-day attendance configuration and date selection logic across frontend (api.js, AdminPage, SuperAdminDashboard) and backend (attendance.py, working_committee_attendance.py) to dynamically evaluate the current date in Indian Standard Time (Asia/Kolkata). Today's date is now guaranteed in configured dates with high-visibility 'TODAY' badges, and the UI automatically defaults to today's date rather than locking on stale cached past days.; Working Committee Attendance Simplified to Present & Absent Marking: Removed Check-In / Check-Out workflow for Working Committee members. Replaced with direct, 1-click 'Present' (emerald) and 'Absent' (rose) marking controls in the SuperAdmin dashboard table with active status indicators, locked session enforcement, and updated metrics (Total Members, Present, Absent, Not Marked).; Working Committee Attendance Backend Direct Mark Endpoint: Added POST /api/working-committee-attendance/mark supporting status 'PRESENT' or 'ABSENT' with audit logging, and updated roster computation to aggregate Present, Absent, and Not Marked counts cleanly.; Consolidated & Working Committee Attendance Sheets in Excel Exports: Added dedicated 'WORKING COMMITTEE' attendance sheet and combined 'CONSOLIDATED' attendance sheet (unifying Department Volunteers and Working Committee members with Member Type, AUID, Role/Domain, Status, Timestamps, and Marked By) to all attendance Excel exports across backend/app/routes/attendance.py, working_committee_attendance.py, and superadmin.py.

AKV Nuditaranga 2026 v2.3.13: Volunteer Attendance 1-Day Count Logic: Updated attendance days calculation across attendance and working committee modules (attendance_units, make_dept_row, and make_wc_row) so that whenever a volunteer has completed attendance (checked in and checked out for an hour/shift), it counts as 1 full day of attendance (1.0 units).; Superadmin Volunteers Directory Total Days Sync: Updated /api/superadmin/volunteers to count completed attendance days directly from AttendanceRecord (records where the volunteer has checked in and checked out or marked COMPLETED) as 1 day each, providing real-time, accurate attendance totals across the Superadmin portal.; Student & Volunteer Profile Days Sync: Synchronized student and volunteer profile statistics in /api/student/me so that completed attendance records with check-in and check-out count as 1 full day present for both attendance_days_present and volunteer_days_present.; Volunteer Attendance Option in SuperAdmin Portal: Added dedicated 'Volunteer Attendance' navigation option to the SuperAdmin portal with direct access to date-based rosters, domain filters, search, camera QR scanner, and manual Check-In / Check-Out controls, enabling SuperAdmins to easily mark and manage volunteer attendance.

AKV Nuditaranga 2026 v2.3.12: QR Scanner Rapid Multi-Fire & Looping Popup Fix: Eliminated the continuous non-stop popups and flood of duplicate attendance requests caused by stale closure state and unpaused video frames in CameraQRScanner.; Atomic Ref-Level Throttling & Immediate Camera Teardown: Introduced synchronous isLockedRef and scanInProgressRef locks across CameraQRScanner, AdminPage, and SuperAdminDashboard, pausing video analysis immediately upon QR detection and closing the scanner modal instantly before the HTTP request is awaited.; Frame Debouncing: Enforced a 3.5-second frame cooldown on identical codes, guaranteeing exactly one API request and one modal popup per scan interaction.

AKV Nuditaranga 2026 v2.3.11: Volunteer Domain Matching Fix: Implemented fuzzy domain normalization and synonym mapping (ignoring casing, whitespace, and 'Domain' suffixes) to ensure volunteers registered under the same domain are always recognized and permitted for attendance marking without 403 or false mismatches.; QR Attendance 1-Hour Lock Workflow: On first scan, automatically marks Check-In and locks the volunteer pass for 1 hour against premature check-out scans. If scanned during this 1-hour window, displays the remaining lockout countdown in minutes.; Coordinator Review & Confirmation for Check-Out (No Auto Check-Out): Scanning the volunteer QR pass after the 1-hour window verifies the shift and displays the volunteer details with an explicit 'Confirm Check-Out' button so the coordinator can review and manually choose to record check-out instead of automatically committing check-out on scan.; Real-Time Pop-Up Confirmation Windows: Integrated dedicated AttendanceScanResultModal displaying 'Check in successful' with pass lockout details on 1st scan, and 'Checkout successful and attendance is submitted for today' upon confirming check-out.; Manual Check-In & Check-Out Suite: Added dedicated Manual Check-In / Out modal with search by AUID, USN, Reg ID, or Name, as well as direct row action buttons for both Admin and Superadmin portals.

AKV Nuditaranga 2026 v2.3.10: Superadmin Portal Modular Simplification: Restricted the standard Superadmin dashboard navigation strictly to 7 core modules: Dashboard Overview, My Profile & Attendance, Working Committee Directory, Event Registrations, Reels & Posts, Event Configurations, and Karunada Vaibhava Schedule.; Dedicated Developer Portal (https://akv.acharyahabba.com/developer): Created independent /developer route and stealth terminal console with full access to all deployed Superadmin capabilities plus advanced developer tooling.; Confidential Developer Authentication: Seeded and configured root developer credentials (username: 'nanu', password: 'nanu@ayush') with stealth login form displaying placeholders strictly as 'confidential' without any example hints.; Directory Confidentiality & Isolation: Completely hidden developer account 'nanu' from all student, volunteer, admin, working committee, and attendance directories; strictly filtered out Superadmin accounts from Admins & Faculty directory.; Superadmin Profiles Management: Implemented comprehensive Developer SuperAdmin Manager allowing the developer to view, inspect plain passwords, create, modify, and delete Superadmin profiles with full audit logging.; Developer Diagnostics & Telemetry: Added live system telemetry dashboard providing real-time database table counts, engine metrics, operational health status, and multi-node cache flush controls.

AKV Nuditaranga 2026 v2.3.9: Fixed Modal Deadline Header: Corrected the outdated deadline text in the One-Time Profile Update modal from October 5, 2026, 11:59 PM IST to October 9, 2026, 2:00 PM IST (09/10/2026 14:00 IST), unifying all banner and modal timestamps under a single source of truth.; Eliminated [object Object] API Error Display: Upgraded readApiResponse in api.js and error handling in MyProfileAttendance to parse FastAPI/Pydantic validation error arrays and objects into clear, human-readable error messages instead of rendering [object Object].; Robust Profile Update Validation & Support for Master Accounts: Expanded OneTimeProfileEditRequest validators in auth.py to allow hyphens and underscores in AUIDs (supporting ADM-MANE and official superadmins), accepted registered and valid emails, relaxed semester bounds (0–12), and sanitized phone numbers to 10 digits before saving.; Volunteer & Admin Password Visibility in Superadmin Portal: Backfilled plaintext passwords across SQLite and PostgreSQL for legacy accounts; updated /api/superadmin/volunteers and /api/superadmin/admins to expose plain_password; eliminated stale caching in api.listAllVolunteers; and replaced unavailable legacy text with clear guidance and quick password presets.; Administrator Details & Password Modal: Added full details popup modal for administrators in SuperAdminDashboard featuring show/hide password toggle, clipboard copy, and direct 'Change Password / Assign New Password' functionality.; Superadmin Direct Password Set API: Implemented POST /api/superadmin/users/{user_id}/set-password and api.setSuperAdminUserPassword allowing Superadmin to directly assign and update passwords for any volunteer, administrator, or student account.; Restored In-Portal Forgot Password Workflow: Implemented missing frontend methods api.forgotPassword, api.verifyResetOtp, and api.resetPasswordWithOtp in api.js; removed restrictive email domain checks; and ensured instant OTP display (dev_otp) when SMS gateway is unconfigured or offline.

AKV Nuditaranga 2026 v2.3.8: Volunteer Attendance QR Pass & Scanner: Added scannable attendance pass QR card to volunteer profiles in MyProfileAttendance, and integrated CameraQRScanner into Admin and Super Admin attendance windows for instant one-tap Check-In / Check-Out.; Profile Update Window Reopened: Extended the one-time profile update window till 09/10/2026 14:00 IST (2026-10-09T14:00:00+05:30) across backend validation and frontend profile editing UI.; Superadmin Volunteer Management Details & Account Password: Added plain_password column to User model with SQLite and PostgreSQL migrations; updated /api/superadmin/volunteers to return complete registration info; added popup modal in Superadmin Volunteer Directory displaying full registration details and account password with show/hide toggle and copy button.; Cultural Event Registrations Display & Group Popup: Displayed event title prominently above Event ID badge (ID: <event_id>); clicking group registrations opens a comprehensive popup modal displaying team leader and full roster of team members with close option.; Attendance Marking Cutoff Date: Enforced attendance marking cutoff till 05/11/2026 across backend routes and Admin / Superadmin attendance sheets, automatically disabling attendance marking thereafter.; Superadmin Daily Attendance Mobile Layout: Rearranged Daily Attendance Record layout for mobile screens (< sm) into responsive touch cards with zero horizontal overflow and large Check In / Check Out buttons alongside the desktop table.; Admin Portal Simplified Volunteer Table: Streamlined attendance marking layout to a compact table displaying only Volunteer Name, small Domain, AUID, and Check-In / Check-Out action to prevent accidental wrong markings.; Superadmin Directory Separation: Cleanly segregated directories in Superadmin portal into Admins & Faculty Directory, Volunteers Directory, Participants Directory (defaulting to Participant filter), and Working Committee Directory.; Role-Specific Website Updates Message Bar: Added RoleUpdatesBanner component mounted across Superadmin, Admin, Volunteer, and Participant dashboards displaying tailored release updates on login with close option and What's New modal.

AKV Nuditaranga 2026 v2.3.7: Mascot Image Whitelist & Cache-Bust Fix: Updated .vercelignore to explicitly whitelist public and dist images, ensuring /images/nograj.png is never excluded during Vercel deployment, and added cache-busting query parameter (?v=2026) to force immediate browser & CDN refresh.

AKV Nuditaranga 2026 v2.3.6: Vercel Deployment Size Optimization: Configured .vercelignore with comprehensive exclusion rules filtering out ~31.5 MB of unreferenced mockups, duplicate public images, local SQLite database dumps, and test scripts while preserving all local files intact on disk.

AKV Nuditaranga 2026 v2.3.5: Fast2SMS Direct Mobile OTP Dispatch: Created sms_service.py integrating Fast2SMS (bulkV2 route) to send real-time 6-digit OTPs directly to registered mobile phone numbers (User.phone).; Multi-Identifier Account Lookup: Updated /api/auth/forgot-password, /verify-reset-otp, and /reset-password-otp to support 10-digit mobile phone numbers in addition to AUID and college email.; Dual-Channel Delivery & Fallback Resilience: Dispatches OTP via mobile SMS as primary channel and college email as secondary backup channel, ensuring students always receive their OTP code.; Updated In-Portal Reset Modal: Added mobile number support to step 1 input and masked phone indicator (e.g. ******3210) to step 2 verification card.

AKV Nuditaranga 2026 v2.3.4: In-Portal 6-Digit OTP Password Reset Wizard: Upgraded the password reset flow to a unified 3-step in-portal modal wizard (Identify -> Verify OTP -> Set New Password), eliminating dependence on external email redirection links and in-app browser routing.; Bilingual OTP Email Template with High-Visibility Code Block: Enhanced send_password_reset_email in email_service.py to prominently render the 6-digit OTP in the email subject and inside a high-contrast amber code card with 10-minute validity notice.; Dedicated OTP Verification & Reset Endpoints: Implemented POST /api/auth/verify-reset-otp and POST /api/auth/reset-password-otp in auth.py with bound user hashing to prevent collisions.; Client API Integration & Resend Cooldown: Added verifyResetOtp and resetPasswordWithOtp to frontend api.js, along with a 30-second resend countdown timer and masked email indicators.

AKV Nuditaranga 2026 v2.3.3: Precise SMTP Diagnostics & Error Reporting: Enhanced email_service.py to track _LAST_EMAIL_ERROR and report actionable root cause reasons (such as missing SMTP_PASSWORD in Vercel or socket timeout) in HTTP 502 responses.; Proactive Unauthenticated Relay Guard: Pre-validated SMTP credentials before attempting network socket connection, preventing unauthenticated connection drops and immediately advising configuration in Vercel settings.; Flexible Environment Variable Resolution: Added fallback resolution in config.py for SMTP_PASSWORD, BREVO_SMTP_KEY, BREVO_KEY, and MAIL_PASSWORD with quote stripping.; Fast Serverless Port Failover & Cooldown Resilience: Tuned connection timeout to 5s per port for responsive failovers on port 587 and 465 SSL, and prevented circuit-breaker cooldown from locking out single-relay retries.; Interactive Forgot Password Modal Support: Updated ForgotPasswordModal with bilingual error messaging and direct coordinator email link (akv@acharya.ac.in) for immediate student support.

AKV Nuditaranga 2026 v2.3.2: Brevo Multi-Port Relay (587 & 465 SSL) Configured: Set default production SMTP relay to Brevo relay with verified akv@acharya.ac.in sender and env-driven authentication.; Dual-Port SMTP Failover: Implemented automatic port 587 -> port 465 (SMTPS SSL) fallback in send_via_relay to bypass serverless port-blocking and handshake timeouts.; Password Reset Delivery Verification: Raised HTTP 502 with accurate delivery failure details when SMTP dispatch fails, preventing false 'Instructions Sent' success dialogs.

AKV Nuditaranga 2026 v2.3.1: PostgreSQL PgBouncer & Supabase Pooler Prepared Statement Fix: Resolved '(psycopg.errors.InvalidSqlStatementName) prepared statement "_pg3_1" does not exist' during Forgot Password and multi-query transactions by setting prepare_threshold=None in psycopg3 connect_args, switching serverless PostgreSQL to NullPool to eliminate connection leaks across PgBouncer/Supavisor, and configuring expire_on_commit=False in SessionLocal.; Password Reset Query Optimization: Extracted user_id, user_email, and user_name before db.commit() in /api/auth/forgot-password to avoid post-commit attribute re-querying.; Custom Subdomain Integration (akv.acharyahabba.com): Configured default production FRONTEND_URL to https://akv.acharyahabba.com, added origin and regex matching to FastAPI CORS middleware, updated canonical link & social sharing OpenGraph tags with absolute asset URLs in index.html, and added robots.txt & sitemap.xml.

AKV Nuditaranga 2026 v2.2.66: Added clean, accessible Portal Settings option to the student login and registration views in the top navigation bar header.; Enhanced PortalSettingsModal with bilingual language preferences (Kannada/English), festival guidelines & rules link, and official contact directory (Ayush H Mane & Priyanka S Reddy).; Strictly omitted the Superadmin login access section and button from the settings modal and student portal views to prevent exposure.

AKV Nuditaranga 2026 v2.2.65: Enabled PostgreSQL row-level security on public.working_committee_day_sessions, public.working_committee_audit_logs, and public.karunada_schedule_days; direct API roles remain denied unless explicitly granted by policy, while the backend table owner retains access.

AKV Nuditaranga 2026 v2.2.64: Enabled PostgreSQL row-level security on public.attendance_audit_logs, public.festival_event_dates, public.working_committee_attendance, and public.working_committee_day_sessions; direct API roles remain denied unless explicitly granted by policy, while the backend table owner retains access.

AKV Nuditaranga 2026 v2.2.63: Enabled PostgreSQL row-level security on public.events, public.social_posts, public.registrations, and public.attendance_day_sessions; direct API roles remain denied unless explicitly granted by policy, while the backend table owner retains access.

AKV Nuditaranga 2026 v2.2.62: Enabled PostgreSQL row-level security on public.volunteer_attendance, public.users, public.gallery_items, and public.password_reset_tokens; direct API roles remain denied unless explicitly granted by policy, while the backend table owner retains access.

AKV Nuditaranga 2026 v2.2.61: Enabled PostgreSQL row-level security on public.activities; direct API roles remain denied unless explicitly granted by policy, while the backend table owner retains access.

AKV Nuditaranga 2026 v2.2.60: Enabled PostgreSQL row-level security on public.audit_logs, public.checkin_logs, public.admins, and public.attendance_records; direct API roles remain denied unless explicitly granted by policy, while the backend table owner retains access.

AKV Nuditaranga 2026 v2.2.59: SuperAdmin Cultural Event Registrations: Added authorized create, edit, and delete controls with participant details, team data, status management, capacity counts, duplicate checks, and audit logging.
Production release version 2.2.58

AKV Nuditaranga 2026 v2.2.57: Student Registration Default Selection Removed: Cleared default role selection for 'How are you registering? / ಭಾಗವಹಿಸುವಿಕೆ ವಿಧಾನ *' so students explicitly choose between Volunteer and Participant.; Student Registration Role Validation: Added validation alerting students to choose whether they are registering as a Volunteer or Participant if not selected.; Renamed Volunteer Domain Label: Changed 'Choose Working Committee Domain / ಕಾರ್ಯಕ್ಷೇತ್ರ *' to 'Choose Working Domain / ಕಾರ್ಯಕ್ಷೇತ್ರ *' when registering as a Volunteer in student registration.; Unset Promotions Default Domain: Set domain dropdown placeholder to 'SELECT DOMAIN' instead of defaulting to Promotions, with mandatory selection validation for volunteers.; Superadmin Admin Approvals Domain Display: Fixed Working Committee badge below member name in Superadmin Administrator Approval Workflow to display 'Committee Member (akv_domain)' instead of redundantly repeating the AUID.; My Profile AKV DOMAIN & Role Display: Replaced 'Assignment / ID: WORKING_COMMITTEE' with 'AKV DOMAIN: <domain>' for committee members and volunteers, and properly displayed 'Role' (Working Committee, Volunteer, Participant, Faculty Coordinator).; Registration & Profile Year of Study Fix: Added Year of Study selection for Working Committee registration, eliminated legacy backend hardcoded semester=8, and corrected '8th Year' display in My Profile to display the real year of study.; Added Developer Option to AKV Domains: Added 'Developer' as the final option in AKV_DOMAINS across student volunteer registration, working committee registration, profile edit dialogs, admin domain filters, and superadmin attendance roster views and export groupings.; Event Capacity Controls: Allow event capacity values from 0 to 10,000 in the SuperAdmin create and edit forms, and validate the same range in the backend.; Hero Heading Wording: Changed the English hero heading from “The Decadal Festival” to “Decennial celebration”.

AKV Nuditaranga 2026 v2.2.56: Dedicated Mobile Footer Implementation: Configured the clean, centered mobile footer layout featuring the white Acharya logo and AKV logo, official email contact, celebration motto 'ಕನ್ನಡದ ಆಚರಣೆ • ಸಂಸ್ಕೃತಿಯ ಆಚರಣೆ • ಪ್ರತಿಭೆಯ ಆಚರಣೆ', developer attribution, and copyright bar; preserved the comprehensive 4-column layout on desktop.

AKV Nuditaranga 2026 v2.2.55: Reverted footer to the classic original unified design across desktop and mobile, restoring original branding, quick links, festival portals, campus contact, and developer attribution.; Superadmin Portal & Data Loading Acceleration: Optimized database query architecture with composite & foreign key indexes on registrations(user_id, event_id), users(role, account_status), and volunteer_attendance(date, user_id).; Eliminated Superadmin N+1 Query Bottlenecks: Consolidated 8 separate queries into 2 batched group_by aggregations in get_superadmin_stats; replaced 1-query-per-student loop in list_students with a single batch group_by aggregation; added joinedload on admin user relations.; Base64 Image Payload Reduction: Deferred heavy photo_url and password_hash columns across volunteer listings, student listings, registration queries, and ID card rosters, reducing API response payload size by >95% and eliminating server/network bottlenecks.; Client SWR (Stale-While-Revalidate) In-Memory Caching & Deduplication: Implemented memory caching and inflight request deduplication in api.js across superadmin stats, students, admins, volunteers, ID cards, official attendance, working committee attendance, and event registrations.; Instant 0ms Superadmin Tab Switching & Eager Prefetching: Initialized Superadmin Dashboard state from client cache and eliminated full-screen spinner flashes on tab navigation; enabled eager background prefetching of all superadmin resources on login.; Complete Removal of Spectators Role: Removed Spectator role option, counters, and filters across student registration (AuthPortal), self-service profile edit (MyProfileAttendance), Superadmin & Coordinator overview metrics, attendance queries, ID card generator, and backend route dependencies.; Elimination of Section Across Entire Platform: Removed Section/Division input fields, displays, and table headers from all UI views (student registration, profile edit modal, student dashboard, check-in verification desk, digital event passes, candidate ID cards, email confirmations, and Superadmin Excel exports); preserved database column default ('A') for schema safety.; Replaced Semester with Year of Study (Options up to 6th Year): Updated all Semester fields, dropdowns, and displays across the website to Year of Study ('ವರ್ಷ (Year)') with options from 1st Year to 6th Year (1st, 2nd, 3rd, 4th, 5th, 6th Year / 1ನೇ ವರ್ಷ to 6ನೇ ವರ್ಷ) to support 6-year courses like PharmD; updated backend Pydantic validations (ge=1, le=6) and database defaults.; Updated Faculty Coordinators Contact Cards Order: Positioned Mr. Tejas K (Cultural Officer, Department of Student Activities) in the first box followed by Mrs. Rakshitha BT (Faculty Advisor, Department of Computer Science & Engineering) in the second box, each with their respective designations, departments, and phone numbers.

AKV Nuditaranga 2026 v2.2.54: Dedicated Portal URL Routing: Assigned individual, distinct URL paths to each portal on the same domain: `/student` for student login, registration, and participant dashboard; `/admin` for coordinator & admin login and dashboard; `/superadmin` for executive superadmin master security login and dashboard; `/faculty` as the dedicated faculty coordinator portal mapping cleanly into the coordinator flow; and `/` strictly as the public festival homepage.; Strict Portal Isolation & Removal of Cross-Portal Links: Stripped cross-portal login and registration links across all portals (no admin or superadmin tabs or links in the student portal, no student tabs on admin/faculty portals, and no public portal switchers in the superadmin portal); removed backdoor PortalSettingsModal from authentication views to prevent superadmin account exposure.; Faculty Role & Portal Architecture: Inspected codebase and confirmed Faculty Coordinator is an admin_type under the ADMIN role (User.admin_type = 'FACULTY_COORDINATOR') rather than an invented standalone role; configured /faculty to pre-select Faculty Coordinator mode with tailored Faculty ID inputs, Acharya email validation, and coordinator dashboard access.; Robust Role-Based Route Guards & Access Denied Views: Enforced client-side and server-side role verification across all portal URLs; authenticated users visiting an unauthorized portal (e.g., students navigating to /admin or /superadmin) are safely blocked with a bilingual Access Notice dialog offering direct navigation to their own dashboard, safe account switching, or returning home without granting unauthorized access.; Session & Post-Login Synchronization: Preserved session handling, 10-minute token password resets (#reset-token), and post-login redirects so users land on their portal's dashboard; configured logout handlers across all dashboards (StudentDashboard, AdminPage, SuperAdminDashboard, Navbar) to cleanly return users to that portal's own dedicated login view.; Vercel SPA Rewrites Verification: Verified vercel.json SPA rewrites (/api/(.*) -> api/index.py, /(.*) -> index.html) so direct visits, browser bookmarks, and page refreshes on /student, /admin, /superadmin, and /faculty work reliably in production while backend API routes remain untouched.

AKV Nuditaranga 2026 v2.2.53: Purge and Exclusion of Super Admin Accounts from Admin Approvals & Directory: Permanently removed legacy accounts (akv-nt-2026 / akv@acharya.ac.in); completely excluded Superadmin profiles from the Administrator Approvals & Directory table in backend queries (GET /api/superadmin/admins, /api/superadmin/admins/pending) and frontend dashboard filtering so that Super Admin accounts are never polluted into coordinator approval rosters.; Profile Photo Upload & AKV Domain Selection in One-Time Profile Edit: Integrated CandidatePhotoUpload in MyProfileAttendance modal allowing all users (participants, volunteers, and coordinators) to update or upload their profile photo, and added AKV Domain selection for participants, volunteers, and working committee members with database synchronization and lock.; Universal Elimination of 'Username' Concept: Removed the concept of username across the entire platform UI: Admin Login now requests 'AUID or College Email' with updated placeholder and error messages; Superadmin Login uses 'Superadmin Access ID'; Admin registration notices confirm by AUID/ID; Super Admin Dashboard table column changed from 'Username' to 'College AUID / Faculty ID'; action prompts and callbacks no longer reference admin usernames; and One-Time Profile Edit modal removed the Admin Username input field entirely.; Admin Removal Foreign-Key Cascade & Safe Response Parsing Fix: Resolved 'Unexpected token I, Internal S... is not valid JSON' error when deleting administrators.
